explanation: It is 0 almost everywhere: at every D1 and D2 step, at every step before about trial 80, and at every GO where the agent picks a1. It jumps to 8-10 only at the GO step late in the episode (trial ~80 onward) when the agent picks a2 right after the first rewarded visit to S2 following a run of a1/S1 trials (either it just switched to a2 and got rewarded, or a rare a1->S2 transition paid off), and it drops back to 0 on later a2 trials once S2 keeps paying.
